name: PdxDropdownMenu
description:
A button that opens a floating menu built from an `items` array, navigable from the keyboard and
closed by an outside click or Escape.
generics: T extends { key?: string; label?: string; type?: string }

members.name: size
members.description: Size of the control (e.g. sm, md, lg).

members.name: placement
members.description: Position relative to the anchor element.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: minWidth
members.description: Minimum width of the menu panel.

events.name: open-change
events.description:
The menu opened (`true`) or closed (`false`): its open state, read-only (#288). The parent
never writes it, so it is not a model, and `::open` on it is an error.

events.name: pdx-select
events.description: An entry was chosen: the menu's own event, re-dispatched on this element.

events.name: pdx-check
events.description: A checkbox or radio entry changed: the menu's own event, re-dispatched on this element.
events.detail: { key: string; checked: boolean; radioGroup?: string; item: MenuItem }

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size of the control (e.g. sm, md, lg).

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Position relative to the anchor element.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

attributes.name: minwidth
attributes.description: Minimum width of the menu panel.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description:
The menu button, when it is not this component's own: an avatar, a chip. The element
placed here gets `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` while open, the keys (click,
ArrowDown/ArrowUp, and Enter/Space when it is not a native button) and the focus back on close.
`label`, `icon`, `variant` and `size` are for the built-in button, and are ignored with it.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Renders one menu entry: a snippet `item(item)`.
slots.signature: (item: Exclude<T | (T extends { children?: readonly (infer C)[] } ? C | (C extends { children?: readonly (infer D)[] } ? D : never) : never), { type: 'separator' | 'label' | 'submenu' }>)
